text: I came to have food particles removed from between my teeth. The dentist and nurse were very attentive and the procedure was quick. I didn't have to wait long. I recommend this clinic.
I went to get a front tooth filled. It was quick, but I wasn't satisfied, so they fixed it about three times. When I got home, I noticed the filling was right next to another tooth! LOL, great!
Went to get my teeth scaled and filled. The receptionist was friendly and spoke politely. The doctor gave me good advice.
